svg.text: PROFILE LOG-LIKELIHOODS AND THEIR WALD QUADRATICS, CUT AT −1.92 FOR 95% INTERVALS
the profile interval for k runs 0.280 below k̂ and 0.518 above; Wald puts 0.365 on each side (SE 0.1863 from the observed information)
the delta method gives D an SE of 0.1220, 90% of its variance from k̂; its interval is symmetric, the profile's is not
